dataList.content:
Where is Heathcliff?
希斯克利夫在哪？
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Fireplace
呼啸山庄 壁炉处

dataList.content:
I haven't a clue. Most likely dozing off in some corner, like the lazy bum he is. Oi, Heathcliff! Where the hell are you? 'Lady Catherine' has finally returned!
难说，不知道那个懒鬼是不是又在哪里睡着了。喂，希斯克利夫！你在哪？凯瑟琳小姐可是在大张旗鼓地找你呢！

Chop chop, come on out and bid her welcome like the other servants have.
你不是该像其他下人一样麻利地滚出来问好吗？

Heathcliff! What are you sulking for...? Have you forgotten me?
希斯克利夫！怎么满脸的不高兴？你把我忘了吗？

How insolent, Heathcliff. I don't recall ever permitting you to act so disrespectfully before my dear sister.
真傲慢啊，希斯克利夫。谁允许你向我的妹妹如此无礼？

Why... are you... laughing at me?
为什么……要嘲笑我？

Huh?
什么？

Why... would you say a thing like that? I... never laughed at you.
为什么……你会这么说？我……从没有想过要嘲笑你。

I simply wanted to know why you don't appear very happy to see me. It's been so long since we've last met.
反倒是你，我们这么久不见，你为什么不高兴呢。

And... my, you are so dirty!
还有……你为什么这么脏呀？

... Hah. Dirty?
……哈，你说脏？

You're right. That's just the way I was born.
是的，没错。我就是这样子出生的。

I like to be dirty, and I'll be as dirty as I want to be!
我喜欢脏，以后也会这么活下去。

What are you... Heathcliff!
什么……希斯克利夫！

The day when Heathcliff denied me for the first time...
希斯克利夫第一次拒绝我的那天……

I've never seen a prouder smile on my brother than when he watched it happen.
哥哥像是得到了这世上的一切般，用无比满足的神情注视着这一切。

I wonder if Heathcliff, who stormed off to the barn...
回到仓库的希斯克利夫……

... was weeping.
会哭泣吗？

Catherine, you shrew... You dare conspire with your husband to take my home away from me?
凯瑟琳……你这狡猾的东西……你和你丈夫共谋夺走了我的家？

The only thing my father ever... ever gave me...!
连父亲留给我的……唯一……唯一的东西也……！

I did not want the pain from your youth to hold you back from living your life, dear brother.
我不希望小时候受过的伤痛成为锁住哥哥人生的脚镣。

The same pain you wielded like a cudgel to thrash Heathcliff. To hurt me.
你将那伤痛当做武器挥向希斯克利夫的同时，我也会深深受伤。

I will try all I can so that you may recover.
我会尽自己最大的努力让哥哥恢复健康。

But if you would rather choose to abandon every opportunity that was ever given to you... if you would rather walk yourself into that abyss...
但是，如果哥哥抛弃所有的机会，选择执意向那深渊走去……
